description: What is inside one database before you fetch it: the columns in each published format with their types, a few sample rows, the row count, the build date and the file sizes. Use this to answer questions about what a database contains without downloading it - the files reach several GB - and to budget a transfer before starting one.

dataset_id.description: A VERSIONED database id, from `versions[].id` in `list_databases` - `bogon_ip_v1`, not `bogon_ip`. The unversioned base id is a license reference and is not accepted here.

name: database_metadata

outputSchema.description: The build document written by the exporter, served through unchanged.

entries.description: Row count in the current build.

sample.description: A few real rows, keyed by format.

sample_entries.description: Row count in the evaluation sample.

sample_size.description: Bytes per format of the evaluation sample, where one is published.

update_freq.description: How often a new build is published.

updated.description: ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) the published build was generated on.

title: Describe a database
